notes.title: Version 1.1 released (September update)
notes.content:
Improved gamepad support
 Other minor fixes, including visual enhancements

notes.title: Cuck Invaders is no more..
notes.content:
..say hello to Silly Squadron!

Soiree Games presents a re-franchised and updated version of the beloved shooter with great many enhancements, including..


    Improved visuals and sound effects
    Bug fixes
    Updated one-player experience


This free update is available now. Have more fun in the Neckbeards-universe!

Note: the title may still be Cuck-related in your games library. However, Steam guys are working hard to change it as you read this.
